6 تلاحظوا (TA) They turned their eyes, [each looking from the outer angle of his eye,] one towards another. (K, L.) ―
-b2- [And hence, (assumed tropical:) They regarded one another; had regard, or an eye, one to another; paid regard, or consideration, one to another. ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) They had a mutual relation, or analogy.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
